tool.name: nf-core bedgovcf
tool.description: Convert a BED file to a VCF file according to a YAML config
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ bedgovcf \\ $args \\ --bed $bed \\ --fai $fai \\ --config $config \\ | bgzip --stdout --threads $task.cpus $args2 > ${prefix}.vcf.gz
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": bedgovcf: \$(echo \$(bedgovcf --version 2>&1) | sed 's/^bedgovcf version //' ) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
